scan_method.question: For each assigned loader-zero address, are all module HIGHLOW references in its +/-0x10 neighborhood direct scalar accesses at the proposed extent, with an independent complete MOV/LEA/PUSH anchor?
scan_method.method: Enumerated every non-ABSOLUTE PE base relocation in ENG1.DLL; matched HIGHLOW fields in the queried cell neighborhoods against complete x86 instructions from each recovery row and remaining .text gaps. Eight fields in uncovered code spans were locally decoded from exact instruction bytes and neighboring control flow. Non-.text fields are recorded as data pointers.
scan_method.limitations: Recovery rows provide firm boundaries where present. Gap instructions are reported with exact instruction bytes and HIGHLOW fixups; masked similarity and caller-implied operands are not treated as owner identity evidence.

cell_extent_surveys.skip_reason: Native DWORD read at RVA 0x34076 accesses [0x6ffd8..0x6ffdb], overlapping this word at offset +2; this word is part of a larger/overlapping object and has no scalar owner proof.

eng1.02290.evidence: Four DIR32 local-code entries are independently bounded inside the complete 0x2290..0x2400 contribution; offset 294 refers to this table base. The 16-byte table ends at 364; the following four bytes are 0x90 padding.
